apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins and lock screen themes
apps.localizedDescription: Customise Apple Wallet card artwork, the lock screen passcode dialer and PosterBoard wallpapers on device, without a jailbreak. AirCard-iOS talks to Apple's internal services through the LocalDevVPN loopback tunnel, which has to be installed as well.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.1

### 📲 Pairing File Import (iOS 18 – iOS 26 Support!)
• **SideStore & LiveContainer Pairing File Support**: You can now import pairing files (`.mobiledevicepairing`, `.plist`, `.mobilepair`) directly from SideStore, LiveContainer, iLoader, AltStore, Jitterbug, or PC/Mac.
• **No iOS 27 Required**: Users on iOS 18.0 through iOS 26 can now fully use AirCard-iOS by simply importing their pairing file from SideStore or LiveContainer.
• **Safe Unpair / Reset**: Added a dedicated "Delete Pairing / Unpair" button to reset or switch pairing configurations without having to reinstall the app.
• **In-App Pairing Guide**: Added a step-by-step setup guide sheet with exact paths to locate pairing files in the Files app (e.g. `SideStore/ALTPairingFile.mobiledevicepairing`).
• **iOS 27+ Gated**: The "Pair on Phone" developer pairing block is now cleanly gated to iOS 27+, avoiding confusion on older iOS versions.

### 💳 Apple Wallet & Card Customization
• **Interactive Photo Cropper**: Added custom zoom, pan, and framing when selecting card artwork (PR #29).

### 🔒 Passcode Themes (.passthm)
• **UTF-8 Encoding Fix**: Fixed filename encoding in generated passcode theme ZIP archives to support non-ASCII characters and localization (PR #12).

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies)
• **Restored Rock-Solid Wallpaper Engine**: Reverted experimental template tracking to restore proven v1.3 Tendies injection, auto-detection of PosterBoard containers, and instant WebKit NeoSpring resprings.

### ❤️ Developer Support & Links
• **Donate Tab in Credits**: Added direct donation options (PayPal, TON, USDT TRC-20, BEP-20) with one-tap copy and quick links to developer socials (@mak5er).
• **Startup Welcome**: Clean notice highlighting developer credits and quick links.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3...v1.3.1

apps.name: Kumone
apps.subtitle: 原生 NetEase Cloud Music iOS 客户端（雲の音）
apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added

- **macOS** (experimental): AutoMix — an Apple-Music-style continuous-playback mode with beat-matched transitions, optional stem separation, loudness compensation and an output-device picker, on a new dual-deck AVAudioEngine backend. Off by default; turn it on in Settings. Thanks @XerWandeRer (#102).
- **iOS**: search and sort within the Liked Songs playlist. Thanks @yamakze (#121).
- **Release**: every release now also ships an AltStore / SideStore source (`altstore.json`) for one-tap sideload updates. Thanks @vancez (#112).

### Fixed

- **iOS + macOS**: home-page loading placeholders and the 新碟上架 album cards stay within the content width instead of overflowing it. Thanks @sld272 (#119).

---

### 新增

- **macOS**（实验性）：AutoMix——类 Apple Music 的连续播放模式,支持节拍对齐的过渡、可选的人声 / 伴奏分离、响度补偿与输出设备选择,基于全新的双 deck AVAudioEngine 后端。默认关闭,可在设置里开启。感谢 @XerWandeRer（#102）。
- **iOS**：「我喜欢的音乐」歌单内支持搜索与排序。感谢 @yamakze（#121）。
- **发布**：每次发布额外提供 AltStore / SideStore 源（`altstore.json`),可在 AltStore 里一键更新侧载。感谢 @vancez（#112）。

### 修复

- **iOS + macOS**：首页加载占位与「新碟上架」专辑卡片不再超出内容宽度。感谢 @sld272（#119）。

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: A battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone, built on Apple's private power-management APIs. It shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what the phone's temperature sensors are doing while it happens.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 修复

- **滑动时每秒卡一下**：在 iPhone 15 Pro 等机型上，任何页面匀速滑动时大约每秒会顿一下，插不插充电器都会出现，现已修复。原因有几处叠加：
  - 表盘中间的数字滚动效果和弧线动画会被放到 CPU 上绘制，页面滚动时每一帧都要重画一次，占用了大量主线程时间。
  - 悬浮读数（画中画）即使没有打开，也每秒在后台画一帧画面。
  - 打开过的每个标签页即使不在前台，也会每秒跟着刷新；当前页面的导航栏和工具栏也每秒重建一次。
  - 读取传感器改到后台线程进行，不再占用界面线程。

## 变化

- 表盘上的功率数字不再有滚动动画，弧线也不再有过渡动画，都和其他读数一样直接更新。
- 切换到别的标签页再切回来时，页面会回到顶部。

感谢反馈这个问题的用户。

---

## Fixes

- **Scrolling hitched about once a second** on every screen, charging or not (reported on an iPhone 15 Pro). Several causes added up:
  - The dial's rolling number and arc animations were drawn on the CPU and redrawn on every scroll frame.
  - The floating meter (Picture in Picture) rendered a frame every second even when it was not open.
  - Every tab you had visited kept refreshing in the background once a second, and the visible page rebuilt its navigation bar and toolbar on every refresh.
  - Sensor reads now run off the main thread.

## Changes

- The power reading on the dial no longer rolls and its arcs no longer animate; they update in place like every other reading.
- A tab returns to the top when you switch back to it.

Thanks to the user who reported it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight, privacy-focused YouTube client for iOS, built with UIKit. SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, up to 1080p playback, background audio, Picture-in-Picture, subtitles and offline downloads — no ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: WrapPin
apps.subtitle: 本机虚拟定位与步行路线测试工具
apps.localizedDescription: 在一张地图上选择、测试并移动 iPhone 向系统报告的位置：支持固定位置、步行与驾车路线模拟、收藏与历史记录，结束后可恢复真实位置。它通过本机配对与设备隧道建立开发者定位会话（默认使用 LocalDevVPN）。这是 Roam Control 的非官方中文分支，仅供在你自己拥有并控制的设备上做开发与测试。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 主要变化

- 修复步行和驾车路线模拟未应用 GCJ-02/WGS84 选择的问题。
- 路线起点、移动点、终点、返程和中断恢复现在会继续使用同一坐标模式。
- MapKit 路线保持原始坐标用于规划和显示，仅转换发送给 iPhone 的模拟坐标。

## 安装

本版提供未签名 IPA，需要使用 SideStore 或自己的开发者身份签名，建议覆盖安装。最低系统为 iOS 27.0。

SHA-256: `6f700a8ce62b2e03e31bb4217d45971b4972b3f62dae8df134091232fc9d9999`

同一功能代码已通过 Build 32 本地测试包的真机验收；正式 IPA 在更新 1.0.12 版本元数据后重新构建，并完成 Archive 和包级校验。
